note: Attacker-controlled fuzz input bytes are passed to the renderer with all extensions enabled, entering the block parser.
A trailing newline is appended to the document buffer, so the buffer always ends with '\n' and the last line's sub-buffer includes that newline.

code: txt_data = data + beg; end = size - beg;
note: The remaining document (including the appended newline) is passed to block parsers such as parse_fencedcode.

For each line inside a fenced code block, is_codefence is called on the line sub-buffer that excludes the trailing newline; the last line is '   ' (3 spaces) and its sub-buffer ends at the document's final newline.

code: c = data[i]; if (i + 2 >= size || !(c=='~' || c=='`')) return 0;
note: The byte data[i] is read before the bounds check. For a 3-space line (size==3), i reaches 3 and data[3] reads one byte past the sub-buffer end, causing the heap-buffer-overflow READ 1.
